techniques.name: Plane-aware multi-series aggregation
techniques.why: Sagittal/coronal/axial emphasize different structures (ACL sagittal, MCL coronal, PF OA axial). Pooling all series together dilutes plane-specific signal and hurts macro AUC equally across 12 targets.
techniques.how: Encode slices → series emb → fixed plane slots + availability mask; never treat missing plane as clinical negative.

techniques.name: Weak supervision from multilingual reports
techniques.why: Only ~58 gold labels vs thousands of reports. Ignoring reports leaves ranking models undertrained; hard pseudo-labels from negation mistakes invert targets.
techniques.how: Negation/uncertainty/temporality-aware parser → soft labels + confidence weights; calibrate on gold folds only; never use test reports.

techniques.name: Small-n gold-set metadata logistic
techniques.why: Hand-tuned plane/fluid offsets only moved public macro AUC 0.494→0.499. The 58 gold labels fitted a 7-d ridge logistic that reached 0.514. That is a fallback, not the day's first cycle.
techniques.how: Keep gold_meta_logit as a deep fallback. Do not resubmit it as cycle 0; ablate ranking changes on top of gold_rank_w50 (0.518).

techniques.name: Plane × protocol interaction ranks
techniques.why: Additive sag/cor/ax fractions plus a global fluid fraction cannot represent 'sagittal fluid-sensitive' (ACL/meniscus/effusion) vs 'axial fluid-sensitive' (PF OA, Baker's). gold_rank_w50 (0.50·7-d + 0.50·interact) is the frozen public floor at 0.518.
techniques.how: Keep the 13-d sag/cor/ax × fluid and × fat ridge (λ=3.5). Next ablation is blend weight, not a new architecture.

techniques.name: Rank-blend weight ablation (0.40/0.60) — done, tied
techniques.why: Public LB rose as interact weight went 0.00 (0.514) → 0.30 (0.516) → 0.40 (0.517) → 0.50 (0.518), then 0.40/0.60 tied 0.518 (gold_rank_w40, 56382621). Weight ablation has stalled; do not resubmit w40/w50/w70.
techniques.how: Keep gold_rank_w50 as the frozen fallback. Do not spend quota on another blend weight.

techniques.name: Interact-head λ ablation (λI=2.0) — done, falsified
techniques.why: gold_rank_lam2 (0.50/0.50, λI=2.0) scored 0.515 on 2026-09-21 (submission 56418615), below frozen gold_rank_w50 (0.518). Lower λ overfit the 13-d head on n=58. Do not resubmit.
techniques.how: Keep gold_rank_w50 as the fallback. Do not spend quota on another λ or blend-weight ablation.

techniques.name: Train-report weak labels on all 4,407 (gold for calibration only) — done, falsified
techniques.why: Fitting 7-d/13-d heads on 58 gold studies is high-variance (σ≈0.0125) and the gold set is prevalence-enriched (~1.5×). Parser-only `weak_rank_calibrate` scored 0.499 (56455239) after overwriting the 58 gold rows. Do not resubmit.
techniques.how: Keep as a documented failure. Next lever is which parser cells are used, not another overwrite of gold 0/1.

techniques.name: Gold-fill weak labels (expert 0/1 + parser on unlabeled) — done, falsified
techniques.why: `weak_rank_goldfill` kept gold 0/1 on the 58 and assigned parser soft labels (including unmentioned=0.38) to ~4,349 reports. Public score 0.504 (56484736): +0.005 vs overwrite, −0.014 vs gold_rank_w50. Keyword mass on unmentioned cells does not transfer to the expert-labeled public LB.
techniques.how: Do not resubmit goldfill. Discussion 734117: empty extractions (~23%) should stay unlabeled, not all-negative. Named objects recover; graded/unstated fail.

Fit 7-d/13-d heads on train-only hybrid Fracture; mix 50/50 only if std>1e-8. Never open test reports. Do not read hybrid ACL/Effusion/OA columns.

techniques.name: Anatomy-oriented multi-task MRI (KAMRNet / slice transformers)
techniques.why: Xie et al. 2025 (eClinicalMedicine) trained KAMRNet on 13,419 patients / 14,962 exams for nine knee abnormalities and reported internal primary AUCs ~0.90; a 2026 23-condition slice-transformer (European Radiology) reached median external AUC ~0.78. Those numbers are the visual-model ceiling, not a metadata ceiling. We cannot spend quota on them until real train DICOMs/JPEGs + GPU time are mounted.
techniques.how: When pixels are available: plane-slot encoder, anatomy-oriented localization, then rank-ensemble with gold_rank_interact rather than replacing it.

techniques.name: Per-target calibrated prevalence prior blend
techniques.why: Macro AUC cares about ranking per target. Pure constant prevalence (~0.49 public) is a floor; blending study-level model logits with target prevalence stabilizes rare labels (MCL, Baker's).
techniques.how: p = clip((1-α)·σ(logit) + α·prev_t); tune α on OOF; larger α for rare/unstable heads.

techniques.name: Fluid-sensitive / fat-suppression series routing
techniques.why: train_series.csv exposes Fluid_Sensitive and Fat_Suppression. Contusion/effusion/synovitis benefit from fluid-sensitive series; bone findings may prefer others.
techniques.how: Weight series embeddings by sequence flags before plane pooling; ablate via ASRA H-routing.

techniques.name: Frozen encoder then last-block unfreeze
techniques.why: Tiny gold set overfits if the full backbone trains early. Frozen ImageNet/RadImageNet encoder + heads first is the reliable baseline.
techniques.how: Train heads only until OOF beats prevalence; then unfreeze last block at low LR.

techniques.name: Target-specific view preference soft regularizer
techniques.why: Hard rules (no sagittal ⇒ ACL=0) destroy recall. Soft preferred-plane coverage features improve ranking without forcing zeros.
techniques.how: Concatenate preferred-plane coverage; small consistency loss only after ablation accepts it.

techniques.name: Ensemble fold checkpoints + rank average
techniques.why: Single fold on 58 labels is noisy. Probability or rank ensembling across folds lifts macro AUC more than architecture churn.
techniques.how: Save fold*.pt; at inference mean probs or average ranks then rescale to [eps,1-eps].
